bio: Near the outskirts of Berlin, this restaurant is housed on the first floor of the European headquarters of the fashion company Clinton. The decor is up to the minute, as is the seasonally influenced cuisine – choose between a four- or six-course set menu and their à la carte Signature dishes, from Berlin Blutwurst, sauerkraut, green back bacon, cassis, mustard to 300g beef – roast beef, fillet, 16hr-cooked ox shoulder, truffle purée, teriyaki, vegetables from the farm. Fans of dry-aged steaks are also in for a treat. The service is attentive and the waitstaff professional. From some tables you can sneak a peek into the Clinton outlet....
